note: Selected original fields, preserved for comparison. This snapshot is not approval or proof of an upstream release.

rows.title: Personnel access or active work versus hazardous energy
rows.required_response: Facility safe state and work-control hold point
rows.evidence_status: TBD site-specific requirement

rows.title: Laser personnel safety
rows.required_response: Inhibit hazardous emission or reach approved personnel safe state
rows.evidence_status: Open requirement

rows.title: Cryogenic fill and coverage permit before drift-HV enable
rows.required_response: Deny energization; if the approved permit is lost while energized apply P-002/P-003 cause/effect
rows.evidence_status: Source-derived concept; initial-fill contract incomplete

rows.title: Low LAr level while drift HV is on
rows.required_response: Trip affected drift HV; latch; notify SC/DAQ/PDS
rows.evidence_status: Source says within 5 cm of top rim; production details require approval

rows.title: Cryostat relief or boiling-risk condition while drift HV is on
rows.required_response: Trip affected drift HV; latch and alarm
rows.evidence_status: Source-derived; condition list incomplete

rows.title: Drift-HV overcurrent or streamer
rows.required_response: Automatic HV safe action; latch; inhibit new ramp; publish cause and waveform reference
rows.evidence_status: Source gives an example of >2x normal for >1 s, not adopted here as approved FD threshold

rows.title: Drift-HV shutdown coordinates associated FC termination bias
rows.required_response: Execute mapped safe action and verify both drift-HV and termination output states
rows.evidence_status: Source-derived; sequence timing incomplete

rows.title: Fire alarm effect on HVS and detector power
rows.required_response: Facility/DPS action to approved zoned safe state; alarm and event record
rows.evidence_status: Partial source-derived; detector-wide scope not approved

rows.title: Rack smoke or fire
rows.required_response: Local/PDU or DPS shutdown; alarm; latch/no automatic restore
rows.evidence_status: Prototype/source-derived; production architecture and threshold approval pending

rows.title: Rack water leak
rows.required_response: Local/PDU or DPS shutdown; alarm; no automatic restore
rows.evidence_status: Source-derived prototype behavior; production scope TBD

rows.title: Rack overtemperature or cooling failure
rows.required_response: Approved autonomous safe action plus alarm; preserve only reviewed essential loads
rows.evidence_status: Prototype uses 60 C fallback; not adopted as universal production value

rows.title: Rack protection controller or sensor-path fault
rows.required_response: Fail safe for credited protection; expose fault and bypass state
rows.evidence_status: Principle source-supported; target response per fault TBD

rows.title: PDS supply current or voltage outside approved safe envelope
rows.required_response: Independent supply/local/DPS trip with verified output readback
rows.evidence_status: Source-derived requirement; no approved values or granular mapping

rows.title: PDS power/readout/calibration equipment overtemperature
rows.required_response: Autonomous local/supply/DPS action; alarm and timestamped cause
rows.evidence_status: Source-derived; device-specific mechanisms/limits incomplete

rows.title: WIEC fan/heater/temperature/dew-point fault
rows.required_response: Action per hazard analysis; do not infer one response for fan, heater, and dew point
rows.evidence_status: Inputs are source-derived; cause/effect remains open

rows.title: Facility power-loss ordering between anode bias and supporting electronics
rows.required_response: Target inequality: hold-up exceeds detection + logic + bias-safe time + margin, or an equivalent hard guarantee
rows.evidence_status: Explicit unresolved conditional risk

rows.title: Cold electronics energization versus cryogenic temperature/immersion state
rows.required_response: No automatic trip or permission claim until damage mechanism and envelope are documented
rows.evidence_status: Open classification

rows.title: Detector-to-building ground impedance fault
rows.required_response: Escalate by classified severity; do not map every impedance warning to detector-wide trip
rows.evidence_status: Historical alarm/human response; detector-damage class unresolved

rows.title: Credited protection input missing stale or broken
rows.required_response: Positive-safety behavior or diagnostically equivalent design; SC displays reason and bypass
rows.evidence_status: Architecture principle; loop-specific responses open

rows.title: Camera illumination versus excluded PDS active state
rows.required_response: Deny the second request; if unexpected light appears then inhibit/turn off the light where possible and invalidate the overlap; do not infer an emergency PDS-bias trip
rows.evidence_status: Mutual exclusion strongly supported by NP02/NP04 operations; PDS damage mechanism not established

rows.title: Ionisation or alignment laser versus excluded PDS active state
rows.required_response: Deny the second request; require verified shutter/emission-off before PDS return; unexpected overlap invalidates data and alarms; no PDS-bias trip without an approved damage case
rows.evidence_status: Mutual exclusion and deliberate handoff strongly supported by NP04 operations; damage mechanism not established

rows.title: Purity-monitor flashes versus PDS measurements
rows.required_response: No PDS bias action; time-stamp PrM requested/active/start/stop and propagate quality metadata
rows.evidence_status: Physical effect source-supported as data quality; Slack documents a historical DAQ-trigger interlock and unreliable-state failure; target no-bias-off policy requires controlled approval

rows.title: PDS LCM or calibration LEDs during acquisition
rows.required_response: Execute approved calibration sequence; publish activity, pulse configuration identity, and affected scope
rows.evidence_status: Source-supported functional distinction; detailed run contract open

rows.title: Power-over-Fiber laser is a VD PDS dependency
rows.required_response: Do not inhibit PoF merely because PDS is active; apply P-011/P-012-style protection to PoF equipment
rows.evidence_status: Source-supported dependency; detailed protection incomplete

rows.title: Unclassified internal light or laser source
rows.required_response: Deny new conflicting activity or clean-physics state; never infer an equipment trip from unknown alone
rows.evidence_status: Proposed conservative operational rule

rows.title: Drift-HV ramp trip or non-nominal state versus physics data
rows.required_response: Run-control admission/state response plus time-aligned HV metadata; protection remains P-001…P-005
rows.evidence_status: Historical operations and proposed FD data contract

rows.title: Cryogenic transient versus physics data
rows.required_response: Publish owner-defined stable/degraded state and underlying metadata; do not reuse protection thresholds as DQ limits without approval
rows.evidence_status: General source support; quantitative FD envelope open

rows.title: Timing not locked or synchronized
rows.required_response: Reject timing-dependent transition and publish reason; tag any acquired interval unknown/degraded
rows.evidence_status: Operational principle; target thresholds/state response open

rows.title: SC DAQ or control-network loss
rows.required_response: Fail closed for commands; never auto-replay or auto-restore power; reconcile actual state on reconnect
rows.evidence_status: Existing draft principle; production policy open

rows.title: DAQ and SC share access to one hardware endpoint
rows.required_response: Reject unauthorized/conflicting request; serialize accepted writes; verify final state and audit actor/config revision
rows.evidence_status: Developed draft principle; architecture approval needed

rows.title: Movable calibration or instrumentation device versus HV and detector state
rows.required_response: Deny request outside approved envelope; actual protective action depends on device hazard analysis
rows.evidence_status: Open detector-wide interaction

rows.title: Expert or subsystem use of detector partition versus shifter run start
rows.required_response: Deny new run/configuration until owner releases scope or run coordinator authorizes a controlled transition
rows.evidence_status: Historical human-interlock evidence; target automation proposed

rows.title: Human response to HV current stream during historical operations
rows.required_response: Historical sequence: inhibit triggers; remove SSP bias; HV expert ramps; log; deliberate restore. Target decomposes each step into ED or DQ/OP row
rows.evidence_status: Historical operations evidence only

rows.title: Protection bypass or temporary override active
rows.required_response: Display and audit bypass; block normal readiness; never allow software bypass of non-bypassable personnel safety
rows.evidence_status: Proposed governance requirement

rows.title: Unknown or inconsistent detector-region mapping
rows.required_response: Fail closed for new activation; select pre-approved conservative scope for active ED hazards; DQ becomes unknown
rows.evidence_status: Proposed systemic requirement

rows.title: Protective-trip recovery and return to run
rows.required_response: Preserve latch/cause and actual state; require explicit authority handback and successful requalification
rows.evidence_status: Established draft principle; per-system procedure needed

rows.title: Individual APA CRP or FC bias-channel electrical or thermal fault
rows.required_response: Remove affected output; latch cause; verify actual voltage and discharge; notify SC/DAQ
rows.evidence_status: Equipment-protection function is supported; limits and coupled grouping are not yet approved

rows.title: Cathode-HV shutdown versus APA CRP bias and TPC electronics
rows.required_response: Preserve actual states and alarm; apply only owner-approved scoped action; FC terminations remain governed by P-005
rows.evidence_status: Historical operations show human shutdown and sequencing; no controlled universal APA/CRP/BDE coupling found

rows.title: Cathode-HV and APA or CRP bias voltage recipe
rows.required_response: Deny an unapproved new transition; if state changes unexpectedly make physics-ready false; hold for expert reconciliation
rows.evidence_status: Historical sequence and run-boundary evidence; production recipe and priority remain open

rows.title: Cathode HV or APA CRP FC bias outside physics recipe
rows.required_response: Do not trip hardware for data quality; publish state transition and affected interval; pause or continue according to the run plan
rows.evidence_status: Historical data-taking practice supports explicit configuration and run boundaries; FD criteria are open
